what: On hover it flips ±angle (default 1.5°) every .3s with no in-between values, jittering endlessly on a .6s cycle, like a hand-drawn animation where only two positions alternate. If children are marked, only those children jitter, and counter children jitter in the opposite direction so picture and text go out of step. With look: swing, on hover it plays once 0 → +angle → 0 → −angle → 0 in two steps per cell and then stops.

options.--fx-angle: Tilt angle (via style), default 1.5deg — Brand logo 1deg · menu text 6deg · menu card image 4deg · share icon 8deg. Each child can be set separately
options.--fx-dur: One cycle length (via style), default .6s — next slide banner image 1s
options.[data-fx-part=shake]: (If any) child to shake — if none, the whole element shakes
options.[data-fx-part=counter]: (If present) Child that shakes in the opposite direction (menu card text · button icon)
options.look: With swing it shakes once and stops instead of trembling endlessly (steps(2, end) · default 1s · default angle 10deg) — Brand paper button

from.where: shared.css sm-shake-N (original shake-N keyframes 0·50·100% +N/10° · 51~99% −N/10°) — header logo 1°, header menu text 6°, browse button text 4° with the icon reversed, menu drawer card image 4° with the text reversed, button 1.5°, share·SNS 8°, next-section banner image 1.5° 1s — all .6s infinite
